title: Home Mortgage Loans: partial payments, prepayment, extra principal minimum and autopay

# Home Mortgage Loans: partial payments, prepayment, extra principal minimum and autopay

This quick-reference card states, for each Home Mortgage Loans program, what happens to a payment smaller than one full installment, the penalty on prepaid principal, the smallest extra principal payment accepted, and whether automatic payment from a PCB account is offered.

## Parameters by program

| Program | Payment smaller than one full installment | Prepayment penalty (% of principal prepaid) | Smallest extra principal payment accepted (USD) | Automatic payment from a PCB account offered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Returned | 0.00 | 25.00 | Yes |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Returned | 0.00 | 25.00 | Yes |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Returned | 0.00 | 25.00 | Yes |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | Returned | 0.00 | 25.00 | Yes |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | Returned | 0.00 | 25.00 | Yes |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | Returned | 0.00 | 25.00 | Yes |

An extra principal payment is also called a principal curtailment.

## Basis Q&A

- **What happens to a payment smaller than one full installment?** In every program it is returned.
- **Is there a charge for paying principal early?** The prepayment penalty is 0.00 percent in every program, so prepaying any amount of principal carries a penalty of 0.00.
- **Can the customer pay the mortgage automatically from a PCB account?** Yes; automatic payment from a PCB account is offered in all six programs.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical extra principal amounts)

| Hypothetical extra principal amount | Against the 25.00 minimum |
|---|---|
| 25.00 | Meets the smallest amount accepted |
| 24.99 | Below the smallest amount accepted |
| 1000.00 | Above the minimum |
